Free Legal Help for LGBTQ+ Ohioans

The Equality Ohio Legal Clinic

When Ohio’s laws leave you out — or the systems around you aren’t equipped to serve you — the Legal Clinic is here. Our services are always free.

Two ways to reach the clinic

Call us, or start a confidential intake online — whichever feels safer.

855‑LGBT‑LAW Start an Intake
What We Help With

Free legal services, built for our community

Consumer law

Fraud, identity theft, debt collection abuse, and unfair practices.

Family law

Support for LGBTQ+ families, including our Ohio LGBTQ Family Law Guide.

Civil rights

Discrimination in housing, employment, and public accommodations.

Administrative help

SSI, disability, name and gender marker changes, and public benefits.

Eligibility

Who can be represented

To be represented by a lawyer from the Legal Clinic, your income must be within 300% of the federal poverty level. Not sure where you fall? Start the intake anyway — our team will walk through it with you, and can connect you to the Attorney Referral Network if the clinic isn’t the right fit.

Submitting an intake does not create an attorney-client relationship. Your information stays confidential within the clinic team.

How It Works

Three steps

1

Tell us what’s happening

Complete the intake online or by phone — about 10 minutes.

2

The clinic team reviews

We confirm eligibility and match your issue to the right help.

3

Get connected

Work with clinic staff or a vetted attorney from our referral network.

For Attorneys

Join the referral network

Ohio attorneys: lend your practice to the community. Network members take vetted referrals from the clinic in their practice area and county — at whatever volume works for you.

Ask about the Attorney Referral Network

You don’t have to navigate it alone.

Start a confidential intake now, or call 855-LGBT-LAW.
